# Vistrow Voice

> AI voice agents that answer, qualify, and book customer calls in 10 Indian languages plus English — inbound, outbound, and web calls, live 24/7. Built by Vistrow.

Vistrow Voice lets businesses put a real-time AI voice agent on every phone call and website visit. The agent answers inbound calls, runs outbound campaigns, answers questions grounded in a business's own knowledge base, and books appointments — in Hindi, Hinglish, and other Indian languages, switching mid-call to match the caller.

## Core capabilities
- Voice Agents: no-code AI agent builder — persona, prompt, voice, language.
- Inbound Calling: answers every incoming call 24/7, qualifies and routes automatically.
- Outbound Campaigns: bulk reminder, follow-up, and collection calls at scale.
- Knowledge Base: retrieval-grounded answers from uploaded PDFs/docs, with a strict mode that disallows hallucination.
- Website Call Widget: a one-tap browser voice-call button embeddable on any website, no phone number required.
- Integrations: webhooks and CRM sync for every lead, transcript, and call outcome.

## Industries served
Real Estate (buyer qualification, site-visit booking), Healthcare & Clinics (appointment booking, patient FAQs), E-commerce & D2C (order status, returns), Finance & Collections (compliant reminder calls), Support & Helpdesk (tier-1 resolution).

## Pricing
Credit-based monthly plans starting at ₹2,999/mo. Full details: https://www.vistrowvoice.com/pricing

## Languages
Artha speaks ten Indian languages — Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Bengali, Gujarati, Malayalam, Punjabi, and Odia — plus English, and switches mid-call to match the caller. It handles everyday code-switching (e.g. Hinglish) and keeps grammatical gender agreement consistent in Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, and Punjabi. Per-language detail: https://www.vistrowvoice.com/languages
